result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major missing-element problem in the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The 'Orders' item in the bottom navigation bar has no icon above its label, while Home, Search, and Profile all display icons. The empty space above 'Orders' makes the navigation look broken and inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Restore the missing Orders icon (e.g., receipt/list icon) above the 'Orders' label, matching the size, stroke weight, and inactive color of the other bottom navigation icons.
